issue.body:
## Outcome

Produce one recoverable GCP Terraform bootstrap.

## Primary deliverable

One recoverable GCP state project backend and deployment-identity bootstrap.

## Verification result

Remote state, locking, recovery, provider pins, impersonation, saved-plan review, break-glass, and local-state removal checks pass.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one recoverable Terraform bootstrap; state creation and migration are internal steps.

## Dependencies

- GCP-A: #490

## Retained predecessor scope

- None; this is new v0.92.1 work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] State is versioned private recoverable and auditable
- [ ] Deployment uses short-lived impersonation
- [ ] Provider and module versions are pinned
- [ ] Local bootstrap state is removed recoverably

## Owned paths

- `infra/gcp/bootstrap/**`
- `docs/operations/cloud/gcp/terraform-bootstrap/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/cloud/gcp-b/**`

## PVF lanes

- `backend-identity`
- `state-recovery`
- `impersonation`
- `provider-pin`
- `local-state-cleanup`

## Stop conditions

- State recovery fails
- Static service-account keys are required
- Reviewed plan identity drifts

## Non-goals

- Runtime deployment
- Production hierarchy
- AWS changes
